pairs.subject: engine-host-contract
pairs.evidence: crates/table-engine/src/native.rs:78 This crate's 'engine' is an external agent CLI (Claude Code / Codex) spawned as an OS child process through tokio Command and driven over JSONL streams, not an embedded language engine with host hooks; a case-insensitive search of crates/table-engine and the workspace Cargo.toml for boa_engine, rquickjs, ModuleLoader, JobExecutor and HostHooks returned no hits, so none of the subject's seams (module loader, job executor, clock hook, job tracing) exist here.

techniques.evidence: crates/table-engine/src/lib.rs:165 The override surface is an adapter over child-process agent CLIs (probe/run/structured/cancel), not a specification-cut host-hook surface of an embedded language engine.

crates/table-engine/src/lib.rs:24 Engines are ClaudeCode, CodexCli and Scripted, all process engines; nothing evaluates guest source or resolves import specifiers, so there's no module loader to contain.
crates/table-engine/src/native.rs:78 Work runs in a spawned OS process, and no promise/job queue is drained in-process, so there's no executor choice to make.
